g.text: Word diversity across each bifolium’s four pages
Each panel is a separate bifolium; circles show the first and last 100 words of each page.
Order within each bifolium: first leaf recto, first leaf verso, second leaf recto, second leaf verso.
All five Bio bifolia and all six Stars bifolia are shown. f116v has no paragraph text in the study transcription.
